questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — समशीतोष्ण घाँसे मैदान।

questions.subject: भूगोल

questions.explanation: उत्तर एटलान्टिक न्यानो धाराले पश्चिमी युरोपको तटीय क्षेत्रमा तापक्रमलाई तुलनात्मक रूपमा मध्यम राख्न मद्दत गर्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — जाडो तुलनात्मक रूपमा न्यानो बनाउनु।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: कृषि भूगोलसम्बन्धी कुन भनाइ गलत छ?

UNGA First Committee मुख्यतः कुन विषयमा केन्द्रित छ?
options: चीन, फ्रान्स, रुस, बेलायत र अमेरिका

questions.question: NASA र IBM ले २०२६ मा चन्द्रमासम्बन्धी कुन AI मोडेल सार्वजनिक गरेका छन्?
IAEA General Conference २०२६ मा कुन अवधिमा आयोजना हुँदैछ?
International Booker Prize को २०२६ पुरस्कार रकम लेखक र अनुवादकबीच कसरी बाँडिन्छ?
काठमाडौँ उपत्यका UNESCO विश्व सम्पदा सूचीमा कहिले सूचीकृत भयो?
Venice Biennale Arte 2026 को शीर्षक के हो?
२०२६ को प्रतिनिधिसभा निर्वाचनपछि सबैभन्दा ठूलो दल कुन बन्यो?
नेपालमा २०२६ सम्म कति भन्दा बढी भाषाको उल्लेख UNESCO ले गरेको छ?
questions.explanation: UNESCO ले २०२६ मा नेपालमा १२३ भन्दा बढी भाषाहरू रहेको उल्लेख गरेको छ।

questions.question: सहज संक्रमण रणनीति नेपालको कुन समसामयिक आर्थिक अवस्थासँग जोडिएको छ?
Choose the odd word.
questions.solution: June has 30 days; the others have 31.

questions.question: Find the missing number: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?
Eye : See :: Ear : ?
questions.solution: An ear is used for hearing.

questions.question: Rina is 12th from the top and 19th from the bottom. How many persons are there?
Find the next number: 4, 9, 19, 39, 79, ?
questions.solution: Each term is doubled and 1 added: 79×2+1=159.

questions.question: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded?
questions.solution: Each letter moves one place forward.

questions.question: तीरको घुमाइको नियम पहिचान गरी प्रश्नचिह्न (?) को स्थानमा आउने दिशा छान्नुहोस्।
questions.solution: माथि र तल पालैपालो; अर्को माथि।

questions.question: Joining the two equal squares side by side forms which figure?
options: A rectangle twice as wide as high
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Two equal squares side by side form a rectangle with a 2:1 width-to-height ratio.

questions.question: Which option is the right-side mirror image?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The order reverses and the arrow direction becomes left.

questions.question: Choose the missing symbol.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The checkerboard pattern alternates ● and ○.

questions.question: Which group completes the sequence?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. The count increases every two steps while fill alternates; next is ●●●.

questions.subject: Non-verbal Reasoning
questions.q: दिइएको ३ तहको समबाहु त्रिभुज जालोमा सबै सम्भावित त्रिभुज गन्दा संख्या कति हुन्छ?
questions.solution: ३ तहको मानक त्रिभुज जालोमा सबै आकार र दिशाका त्रिभुजको कुल संख्या १३ हुन्छ।

questions.question: Find the next number: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Each term is divided by 3.

questions.question: If 2x + 3y = 18 and x = 3, then y is:
Find the missing number: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Each term is previous term ×2 +1.

questions.question: The ratio 18:24 in simplest form is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Divide both terms by 6.

questions.question: A person walks at 6 km/h. How long will it take to cover 15 km?
A company's sales rise from 800 units to 1,000 units. The increase is what percentage of the original sales?

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): An organization should separate approval and payment authorization for major purchases. Reason (R): Separating key controls can reduce the risk that one person can complete an improper transaction without detection.
options: Both are true but R does not explain A
Both are true and R explains A
questions.solution: The reason directly explains the internal-control benefit of separation of duties.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A meeting must include exactly three of four topics A, B, C and D. A cannot be together with C. B must be included if D is included. Which set is possible?
questions.solution: A,B,D satisfies the A-C restriction and includes B whenever D is present.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A four-person panel is selected from A, B, C, D, E and F. A and B cannot serve together. C must serve if D serves. E cannot serve if F serves. Which panel is valid?
questions.solution: B,C,D,E satisfies A-B restriction; D is accompanied by C; E is not paired with F.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: What is the value of x? Statement I: x is an even integer greater than 4 and less than 8. Statement II: x is divisible by 3.
questions.solution: Statement I alone is sufficient because the only even integer strictly between 4 and 8 is 6.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Is integer n positive? Statement I: n² = 9. Statement II: n is not equal to -3.
questions.solution: I gives n = 3 or -3. II excludes -3, so together n=3 and is positive.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: All auditors are analysts. Some analysts are planners. Conclusions: I. Some auditors are planners. II. All auditors are analysts.
questions.solution: Conclusion II directly restates the first statement. Conclusion I does not necessarily follow because the analysts who are planners need not be auditors.

questions.passage: One scientific study rarely settles a complex question. Replication, comparison with other evidence and careful interpretation increase confidence. Good science communication requires both accuracy and clarity.
questions.question: What can excessive technical language do?
questions.solution: The passage emphasises clarity as well as accuracy.

questions.passage: Urban parks provide shade, absorb some rainwater and support recreation. Their benefits depend on location, maintenance, accessibility and safety, not merely on the amount of green space.
questions.question: What broader conclusion follows?
options: Design affects whether benefits are realised
questions.solution: The passage stresses planning and design.

questions.passage: Education should combine foundational knowledge with independent thinking. Memorisation helps with basic facts, while application and evidence evaluation develop deeper learning. Assessment design can influence what students choose to study.
questions.question: Which statement is FALSE?
questions.solution: The passage says memorisation remains useful.

questions.passage: Energy efficiency can reduce resource use without reducing services. Insulation, efficient appliances and sensible operating practices can cut waste. Small improvements can have a large combined effect across many buildings.
questions.question: What is the main point?
options: Small measures can create large combined benefits

questions.passage: Disaster preparedness begins before a crisis through risk identification, communication, evacuation practice and supplies. Plans may fail under unexpected conditions, so post-event review should improve future planning.
questions.question: What limitation is acknowledged?
options: Plans may fail under unexpected conditions
questions.solution: Unexpected conditions can make plans fail.

questions.question: A speech delivered without preparation is
Choose the word closest in meaning to “prudent”.
questions.solution: “cautious” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “demonstrate”.
questions.solution: “demonstration” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The _____ of the school addressed the assembly.
questions.solution: “principal” is the noun meaning the head of a school; “principle” means a rule or belief.

questions.question: In “The reform is likely to alleviate congestion,” what does “alleviate” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “reduce the severity of” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: A person who speaks many languages is called a
In “The organization faces a formidable challenge,” what does “formidable” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “difficult and demanding” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: The committee decided to ___ the proposal until more evidence was available.
The report consists ___ five sections.
questions.solution: The fixed construction is consists of.

questions.question: She usually ___ to work by bus, but today she is walking.
questions.solution: The present simple describes a habitual action.

questions.question: Had the warning been issued earlier, the accident ___.
questions.solution: Had the warning... is an inverted third conditional, requiring might have been prevented.

questions.question: There ___ several reasons for the delay.
questions.solution: The real subject reasons is plural, so are is required.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'Despite being tired, she continued working.'
options: Although she tired, but she continued working.
Because she was tired, she stopped working.
Although she was tired, she continued working.
She continued working because she was tired.
questions.solution: Despite being tired can be expressed as Although she was tired.

questions.question: More than one employee ___ complained about the delay.
questions.solution: More than one normally takes a singular verb.

questions.question: I ___ this book twice, but I still find it useful.
questions.solution: The present perfect describes an experience up to the present.
